routeCharacter: Starts at Tjolöholm estate and uses wooded paths in Storeskog with old oaks and viewpoints.
Gives beach/coastal views toward Tjolöholm castle.
Turns inland south of Tjolöholm because of bird-protection area along the coast.
Passes agricultural landscape and then reaches the sea again at Gårda brygga.
Passes Näsbokrok nature reserve with coastal heath, boardwalk/gravel loop context and rest places.
Finishes on small roads and Åsa kustpromenad to the Åsa/Vita Sand beach endpoint.

Do not use OSM parent relation or local Tjolöholm/Näsbokrok loops as K3 route geometry.

researchIterations.summary: Main thread checked official page/API/GPX/places, K2/K4 endpoint continuity, OSM, Näsbokrok Länsstyrelsen source, Tjolöholm/Kungsbackafjorden carried-forward rules context, Västtrafik line 732, Kungsbacka/Visit Kungsbacka Vita Sand context and Åsa endpoint access.
keyFindings: Official GPX/API geo_json is canonical candidate at 432 points/28.787 km flattened, but it is a three-segment MultiLineString with two short official gaps.
K2/K3 handoff is about 0.29 m and K3/K4 handoff is exact.
Official places API needs limit=100 to return all 21 records.
Åsa idrottsplats is the closest endpoint bus; Åsa station is a strong rail fallback about 2.0 km away.

researchIterations.summary: Six independent reports covered official sources, route geometry, facilities, transit/access, field reports and rules/safety/currentness.
keyFindings: All lanes agreed official GPX/API geo_json is canonical and OSM/Naturkartan are not canonical K3 line sources.
Facilities are concentrated at Tjolöholm, Gårda Brygga, Näsbokrok and Åsa/Vita Sand, with side-service filtering needed.
No active official K3 closure/reroute was found.
No targeted follow-up was needed because remaining questions are import/currentness caveats.

Verify Tjolöholm drinking water with an official or field source before importing it as public drinking water; current evidence is OSM-only.
Verify current seasonal opening/status for Gårda Brygga and Vita Sand toilet/drinking-water facilities before publication.
Verify Åsa Camping, Strandbaren, cafés, Djäknegården and other commercial service opening hours before publication.
Normalize Åsa endpoint food/lodging/service density carefully to avoid over-importing urban services.
Verify live Västtrafik/Hallandstrafiken service for Åsa idrottsplats, Åsa station, Torpa Smedja, Lekarekulle, Flamsnäs, Sannatorpsvägen and Brinkens väg close to publication/travel date.
Run current fire-ban/currentness checks for Kungsbacka/Räddningstjänsten Storgöteborg close to publication/travel date.
Dedupe Tjolöholm start records with K2 endpoint records.
